source_resolution: Source labels resolve uniquely to SHA256-pinned raw files and request metadata in source_manifest.json. Announcement sources corroborate changed dates, not actual completion clocks; the latter are always ESPN period-2 final-whistle wallclocks. All three identified suspensions additionally have official completion reports.

741100.note: KNVB December 1 schedules the remainder for December 2 14:30 after November 30 fireworks. Ajax's dated December 2 report confirms the sixth-minute resumption was completed 2-0. Original day remains November 30; not replaced with the resume time.

741255.note: The December spring program names May 3 16:45 and an explicit conditional May 2 21:00 alternative. Earliest May 2 midnight was frozen before finals. AZ's official result inventory confirms the May 3 league fixture ended 2-2. Its current result page is used only as final corroboration, never as the original source.

740997.note: KNVB August 15 moves August 24 to September 24 20:00 after AZ's Conference League qualification. June's 18:45 alternative conflicts in clock only and is retained. AZ's official results confirm September 24, 2-2. August 24 midnight controls.

741111.note: KNVB December 23 explicitly names original December 14 and January 21 18:45 makeup for European commitments; Excelsior corroborates it. AZ's official results show January 21, 1-1. December 14 remains the original bound.

741267.note: NAC's May 11 completion report confirms Sunday's interrupted match was completed Monday in Friesland, retaining NAC as the home side and the 2-0 score. The physical venue changed for safety; do not rewrite the canonical ordered fixture. May 10 remains the original bound.

741031.note: KNVB August 15 explicitly moves Saturday September 27 to Sunday September 28 14:30 following Feyenoord's European outcome. September 27 remains the earliest baseline.

741135.note: KNVB January 16 identifies the snow-postponed Eredivisie game and announces February 11 21:00 makeup. Original January 9 is preserved from the September first-specific program.

741206.note: KNVB February 2 explicitly moves March 6 20:00 to March 8 20:00 for the cup semifinal calendar. Earlier original midnight is retained; completion on March 8 is charged adverse.

741177.note: Sparta's February 15 notice identifies snow suspension after roughly six minutes and February 17 20:00 resumption. February 17's completion report confirms the remainder ended 1-1. Reports differ by seconds on the suspension minute (6:56 versus 6:45); neither affects the day or conservative deadline, and neither is used as final completion.

741145.note: Excelsior's December 23 announcement identifies a new January 17 20:00 home date. January 16 from the September first-specific program remains the original.

741126.note: KNVB November 13 explicitly moves December 20 16:30 to December 21 16:45 for the cup calendar. December 20 midnight remains the original.

741149.note: KNVB December 23 explicitly moves January 25 to February 11 20:00 at Go Ahead's request. KNVB January 16 adjusts the new clock to 18:45. All earlier originals remain, and no makeup replaces January 25 midnight.

741048.note: The September 10 official announcement explicitly moves October 18 16:30 to October 19 16:45. The June October 18 original is not overwritten.

741122.note: KNVB November 13 explicitly moves December 19 20:00 to December 20 16:30 for the cup calendar. December 19 midnight remains the original.

741209.note: KNVB February 2 advances March 7 to March 6 20:00 as a consequence of N.E.C.–Volendam's move. The original frozen March 7 baseline is retained, with the negative delay visible; this is not a postponement and was not excluded.
